mapper.select: select u.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", u.employee_no as "employeeNo", k.name as "name", coalesce(oum.organization_code, k.organization_code) as "organizationCode", o.organization_name as "organizationName", k.rank_name as "rankName", k.employment_status as "employmentStatus", coalesce(oum.position_name, k.position_name) as "positionName", k.retirement_date as "retirementDate", k.last_synced_at as "lastSyncedAt", u.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", u.status as "status", null as "roleCodes" from users u left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no left join lateral ( select mapping.organization_code, mapping.position_name from organization_user_mappings mapping where mapping.user_id = u.user_id and mapping.mapping_type in ('POSITION','ORGANIZATION') and mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' and mapping.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (mapping.effective_end_date is null or mapping.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) order by case mapping.mapping_type when 'POSITION' then 0 else 1 end, mapping.effective_start_date desc, mapping.mapping_id desc limit 1 ) oum on true left join organizations o on o.organization_code = coalesce(oum.organization_code, k.organization_code) where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status != 'DELETED'
select role_code from user_roles where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE or valid_end_date is null) order by role_code

select ur.assignment_id as "assignmentId", ur.user_id as "userId", ur.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", ur.assignment_type as "assignmentType", ur.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", ur.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", ur.approver_user_id as "approverUserId", ur.status as "status", ur.updated_at as "updatedAt", ur.change_reason as "changeReason" from user_roles ur join roles r on r.role_code = ur.role_code where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.status = 'ACTIVE' and ur.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (ur.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE or ur.valid_end_date is null) order by ur.assignment_type, ur.role_code
select role_code as "roleCode", role_name as "roleName" from roles where status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y' order by role_code
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: update users set system_use_yn = #{systemUseYn}, status = case when #{systemUseYn} = 'Y' then 'ACTIVE' else 'INACTIVE' end, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'DELETED'
update user_roles set status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, change_reason = #{changeReason} where user_id = #{userId} and assignment_type = 'MANUAL' and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into user_roles (user_id, role_code, assignment_type, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, approver_user_id, status, change_reason) values (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'MANUAL', #{validStartDate}, #{validEndDate}, #{approverUserId}, 'ACTIVE', #{changeReason})
